items.heading: Beshbarmak Kyrgyz
details: Key ingredients: boiled meat, flat noodles, onion broth
Boil lamb or horse meat with onion until very tender.
Cook wide noodle sheets in the rich broth.
Slice the meat and arrange it over the noodles.
Pour a warm onion broth over the top before serving.

items.heading: Plov Kyrgyz
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, carrot, garlic, cumin
Brown lamb with onion and cumin until fragrant.
Add julienned carrots and cook until softened.
Layer rice over the meat with whole garlic bulbs.
Add water and simmer covered until the rice is tender.

Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.

items.heading: Plov
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.
